items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: in the trumpet section Nicholas Payton was on trumpet and we had James Olen on trumpet, Curtis Fowlkes trombone, Steven Bernstein, trumpet, and we had Kevin Mahogany did the vocals.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Henry Butler was on piano. We had Mark Whitfield on guitar. And we had Jessie Davis on alto saxophone, David “Fathead” Newman on saxophone, Craig Handy on saxophone, James Carter on tenor saxophone, Don Byron on baritone saxophone and clarinet, and in the trumpet section Nicholas Payton was on trumpet and we had James Olen on trumpet, Curtis Fowlkes trombone, Steven Bernstein, trumpet, and we had Kevin Mahogany did the vocals. So it was a good tour. And the band rocked the house. The band, we had, we…
I think the fellow did a good job with how they presented the music in that film.
